ga.title: Truck-Crash Deaths in Georgia, 2020–2024: What the Federal Crash Data Shows
ga.meta_title: Georgia Truck-Crash Deaths, 2020–2024: A Data Study
ga.meta_description: 1,151 people died in 1,042 truck-involved fatal crashes in Georgia from 2020 to 2024, and 82% were outside the truck. NHTSA data, with the dataset.
ga.excerpt: Between 2020 and 2024, 1,151 people died in 1,042 fatal crashes in Georgia that involved a large truck, 13.6% of the state's fatal crashes. 82% of those killed were outside the truck. Analysis of NHTSA FARS data, with the dataset and code published.

sc.meta_title: South Carolina Truck-Crash Deaths, 2020–2024: Data Study
sc.meta_description: 669 people died in 601 truck-involved fatal crashes in South Carolina from 2020 to 2024; 64% of the crashes were rural. NHTSA data, with the dataset.
sc.excerpt: Between 2020 and 2024, 669 people died in 601 fatal crashes in South Carolina that involved a large truck, 12.0% of the state's fatal crashes. 86% of those killed were outside the truck, and 64% of the crashes were on rural roads. Analysis of NHTSA FARS data, with the dataset and code published.
